name: specific crash
text: The game crashes every time I open the inventory after the latest update.

name: positive gameplay
text: The combat feels great and the world design is excellent.

name: feature request
text: Please add manual save slots and a better inventory filter.

name: performance complaint
text: The frame rate stutters badly on Steam Deck after entering a crowded area.

name: controller complaint
text: Controller support is broken: the right trigger stops responding in menus.

name: Steam Deck complaint
text: On Steam Deck the game freezes during loading and the battery drain is severe.

name: localization complaint
text: The Vietnamese subtitles are missing and several menu strings are untranslated.

name: Vietnamese bug report
text: Trò chơi bị treo khi mở kho đồ và mất kết nối thường xuyên.

name: joke or meme
text: 10/10 would let the tutorial boss destroy me again.

name: multiple issues
text: The save system is unreliable, matchmaking disconnects, and the UI is hard to navigate.
